strings.59-ФЗ статья 12 Теперь известно, чья сет: 59-FZ Article 12 The network owner is now known
strings.59-ФЗ, статья 12, часть 1: рассмотрение: Federal Law No. 59-FZ, Article 12, part 1: reviewing a submission within the scope of competence.
strings.Авторское учебное изложение закона: Author's training summary of the law
strings.В вымышленной рабочей схеме предусмотрен: The fictional workflow provides for referral to the duty service through the specialist department and separate confirmation that a barrier is in place. The final repair requires its own confirmation.
strings.В данном упражнении счёт начинается со с: In this exercise, counting starts on the day after registration; a deadline falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day. This is a separate task about the deadline for the specified action, not about fully resolving the real-life problem.
strings.В отличие от исходного люка владелец и к: Unlike the original manhole case, the owner and communication channel are established; action through them is required, not indiscriminate circulation.
strings.В пределах компетенции профильного отдел: Within the specialist department's competence, relay information to the duty service through the confirmed procedure; handle the submission separately.
strings.В приложении к письму указан дежурный го: The letter's annex names the city service's duty officer; the request is referred through our specialist department.
strings.В учебной схеме отдел отвечает за органи: In the training workflow, the department is responsible for organisational coordination concerning the specified site. You relay reports and prepare a reply, but do not promise repair dates that the contractor has not confirmed.
strings.Вы в прошлый раз выясняли, чей это колод: Last time you were finding out who owned this manhole. I brought a letter from the service: its number matches the diagram. But the cover is still missing, and the dispatcher says your department must forward the request.
strings.Выясните, что именно произошло и что под: Establish exactly what happened and what the materials confirm.
strings.Граждане и все материалы инцидента вымыш: The citizens and all incident materials are fictional. Any conditions of a particular service given here are a training model, not a quotation from real regulations. Act within your role. The calendar task concerns only the action it specifies.
strings.Да, в письме К-17, и на схеме тот же ном: Yes, the letter says K-17, and the diagram shows the same number and courtyard entrance.
strings.До ответа по обращению информация о риск: Risk information stays in the correspondence office until the submission is answered.
strings.Есть ли сведения о состоянии сейчас?: Is there information about the current condition?
strings.Завершить дело по любому номеру полученн: Close the case using any received request number.
strings.Заново разослать полное дело всем возмож: Send the entire file again to every possible owner without relaying an urgent report.
strings.Использовать подтверждённую идентификаци: Use the confirmed identification for targeted referral and verification of the result.

Use the confirmed identification for targeted referral and checking the outcome. Unlike the original manhole case, the owner and channel are established; action through them is required, not indiscriminate circulation.

Which facility identifier must be retained when forwarding? Link the extracted information to the decision based on the materials.
strings.Контакт обосновывает маршрут, а не факт: A contact establishes the referral route, not that the work has been completed.
strings.Крайний день рассмотрения обращения: Last day for reviewing the submission
strings.Любой колодец автоматически обслуживает: Any manhole is automatically maintained by the district administration based on the district's name.
strings.Материалы позволяют передать заявку уста: The materials allow the request to be referred to the identified contractor; identifying the owner again must not delay the urgent measure.
strings.Можно ли уже обещать окончательный ремон: Can the final repair already be promised?
strings.На снимке от {{observed}} колодец открыт: The photograph dated {{observed}} shows the manhole open. The inspection record notes this too.
strings.Найдите применимое положение, проверьте: Find the applicable provision, check its connection to the materials and justify the action. Training material is not a normative legal act.
strings.Найдите статью об общем сроке рассмотрен: Find the article on the general deadline for reviewing a written submission within the scope of competence.
strings.Написать, что работы не требуются, раз д: Write that no work is needed because the dispatcher has replied.
strings.Не заменяет специальную норму: Does not replace a special provision
strings.Обращение рассматривается в пределах ком: An appeal is considered within jurisdiction; any special procedure requires a separate check. General written-reply periods are not the same as deadlines for repairs, benefits or register corrections.
strings.Объект идентифицирован по двум материала: The site is identified by two materials.
strings.Обязать заявителя самостоятельно закрыть: Require the applicant to cover the manhole personally.
strings.Оперативная мера и полный ремонт разделе: The urgent measure and the full repair are separate.
strings.Отправлено {{sent}}, поступило {{receive: Sent on {{sent}}, received on {{received}}, registered on {{registered}}. The latest event in the materials is dated {{observed}}. Do not confuse the complaint deadline with the service deadline or the time needed to resolve the problem.
strings.Первый фрагмент пересказывает условие за: The first passage restates the task conditions, not real regulations or a website extract. The external link verifies the legal basis, not the incident's facts.
strings.Передать сведения об опасности и получит: Relay the danger information and obtain confirmation of receipt
strings.Письмо городской службы и схема относятс: The city service's letter and diagram concern manhole К-17. Its inspection report confirms an open access opening. The internal diagram identifies the duty service as the recipient of an operational report.

strings.После нахождения телефона можно закрыть: Once a telephone number is found, the case can be closed.
strings.Последующий результат проверен по сущест: The subsequent result has been checked against the substance of the case.
strings.Прекращение работы без выяснения обстоят: Stopping work without clarifying the circumstances
strings.Проверить временную безопасность и отдел: Check temporary safety measures and the repair outcome separately

strings.Профиль исчисления этого упражнения: исх: This exercise's calculation profile excludes the starting day and rolls the deadline forward, using the federal five-day working week. It is not a rule for every procedure.

strings.Рассмотрение обращения по закону № 59-ФЗ: Review of a submission under Law No. 59-FZ
strings.Сведения о другом заявителе, объекте или: Information about another applicant, facility or period does not replace verification in this case. A body's name does not grant an employee unlimited powers.
strings.Сверить идентификатор в переданной заявк: Verify the identifier in the referred request and correct its destination for the contractor, retaining oversight of K-17.
strings.Сначала определите действие, для которог: First identify the action to which the deadline applies. Applying for a service, registering a complaint and resolving a problem are not the same event.
strings.Совпадает ли номер колодца в письме и на: Does the manhole number in the letter match the diagram?
strings.Сообщить заявителю, какие действия выпол: Tell the applicant what actions have been taken without promising unconfirmed repairs
strings.Сопоставить код К-17, место и актуальный: Compare code K-17, the location and the current record
strings.Сопоставьте вывод с документами и провер: Compare the conclusion with the documents and check the limits of authority.
